issues: 22 个词各取随机 hsl（蓝→粉紫），整屏高饱和彩虹堆砌
每个词都挂 16px 彩色辉光，远近一样亮，读不出空气与纵深
近镜头只有各向同性 blur，没有沿飞行方向的速度线，"擦身而过"不成立
背景是单一径向渐变，没有颗粒和暗角，隧道里空空荡荡
changes: 透视改为手算投影（scale = 1100/(1100−z)，与 CSS perspective 逐点等价），按每个词屏幕空间速度套径向方向性 SpeedBlur，近镜头拉出速度线；原近端模糊系数 26→18 分担
配色收成冷白三阶 + 4 个靛蓝强调词，辉光只留给强调词，其余只有 6px 极弱冷光
远端前 22% 行程加 ≤0.9px 大气雾失焦；新增 40 颗沿同一隧道运动的细尘埃做纵深参照
底改带色相的深蓝黑三段径向 + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒；字体换系统字栈 700、-0.015em
z 线性推进、黄金角铺位、[0,1,0.5,0.2,0] 生命曲线、CYCLES=2 首尾无缝全部保留
issuesEn: Each of the 22 words took a random hsl (blue to pink-purple) — a saturated rainbow pile
Every word carried a 16px colored glow at equal strength near and far, so there was no air or depth
Near the camera there was only isotropic blur, no streaks along the flight path — the fly-by never sold
The background was a single radial gradient with no grain or vignette; the tunnel felt empty
changesEn: Perspective is projected by hand (scale = 1100/(1100−z), point-for-point identical to CSS perspective) so each word gets a radial directional SpeedBlur from its screen-space velocity; near-end blur coefficient 26→18 to share the load
Palette reduced to three cool whites plus four indigo accent words; only accents glow, the rest get a faint 6px cool halo
Atmospheric defocus (≤0.9px) over the first 22% of travel; added 40 fine dust motes riding the same tunnel as a depth reference
Ground is a hue-tinted three-stop navy radial with vignette and soft-light grain; type switched to the system stack at 700, -0.015em
Linear z travel, golden-angle layout, the [0,1,0.5,0.2,0] life curve and the seamless CYCLES=2 loop are all kept
